In this video, we break down the key announcements from Union Budget 2026 and what they actually mean for India’s future.
We discuss:
• Why there were no major tax benefits for individual taxpayers
• The shift from consumption to long term capital expenditure
• Semiconductor Mission 2.0 and India’s push for chip design and manufacturing
• Rare earth mining corridors and why they matter geopolitically
• PLI 3.0 and the move from assembly to advanced manufacturing
• The sharp increase in defence capex and focus on aerospace
